steps.note: A TLS handshake that fails inside a CONNECT or SOCKS tunnel is caught by UpstreamProxyRelayHandler.exceptionCaught, whatever the failure: one WARN 'SSL or decoder fault caught by upstream relay handler -> closing pipeline <channel>'. On SOCKS the 8.0.0 oracle sometimes also logs a port unification fault for its loopback connection (SNI mocked.example.test); that racy entry is masked away.
cleartext CONNECT, then a ClientHello too short to decode: decode_error alert
logs after: cleartext CONNECT, malformed ClientHello

mask.regex: ------------------------------------\n<timestamp> - SSL or decoder fault caught by port unification handler -> closing pipeline \[[^\]]*\] \(SNI: mocked\.example\.test\)\n

steps.note: cleartext CONNECT, then a TLS 1.2 ClientHello and, after the server's flight, a fatal certificate_unknown alert (a client that does not trust the CA)
logs after: cleartext CONNECT, client rejects the certificate

mask.regex: ------------------------------------\n<timestamp> - SSL or decoder fault caught by port unification handler -> closing pipeline \[[^\]]*\] \(SNI: mocked\.example\.test\)\n
